event_title: Files paperwork for a 2026 reelection bid
stated_purpose: Open a reelection committee ahead of the June 2026 primary
observable_function: Filing and fundraising launch reported by the L.A. Times
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: an early filing, 23 months before the runoff, consistent with an incumbent clearing the field.
main_messages: "We cannot afford to stop our momentum" (L.A. Times headline)
analyst_notes: Headline and lede only: the article is metered and the full text was not retrievable.

event_title: Reelection campaign launch rally
venue: Los Angeles Trade-Technical College, Culinary Arts event space
observable_function: Rally with family, allies and elected officials; candidate speech
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: staged as a coalition demonstration (labor, business, faith, elected officials) rather than an ideological rally.
main_messages: Safer and more affordable city; standing up to the Trump administration; Palisades recovery; Inside Safe results
policy_issues: Homelessness; affordability; public safety; wildfire recovery; immigration
speech_summary: Recounted the Palisades fire recovery, affordability and homelessness work, touted Executive Order No. 1 and Inside Safe, and promised not to rest "until every Palisadian is back home".
media_coverage: ABC7 Los Angeles (CNS wire); L.A. Sentinel
opponent_reference: Did not name President Trump directly but framed the race around resisting his administration
analyst_notes: ABC7 dates the rally to "Saturday" (Dec. 13, 2025) and publishes Dec. 14. Attendee list is quoted from the wire copy.

event_title: American Federation of Musicians Local 47 endorsement
observable_function: Endorsement release posted by the union
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: early labor consolidation behind the incumbent.
main_messages: Union support for the mayor
analyst_notes: No event venue or date-of-event reported; the row records the dated public endorsement, not a rally.

event_title: Sherman Oaks Homeowners Association runoff debate
venue: Sherman Oaks East Valley Adult Center, 5056 Van Nuys Blvd.
stated_purpose: First runoff debate, sponsored by the Sherman Oaks Homeowners Association
observable_function: 90-minute debate carried live on LAist 89.3 and online
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: the runoff opened in the same homeowner venue as the primary, with affordability as the announced frame.
target_audience: Valley homeowners and citywide broadcast audience
main_messages: "I'm frustrated too. But ... frustration makes me fight even harder"; record of decline reversed
speech_summary: Bass conceded voter frustration and converted it into a fight message; defended her record on homelessness and housing permits.
media_coverage: LAist (preview and live audio); CalMatters; Sherman Oaks HOA video
analyst_notes: "You want to hear frustrated? ... I'm frustrated too" is quoted in the LAist preview as said "at a recent campaign event", not necessarily at this debate.

event_title: South L.A. mayoral forum (A Place Called Home)
stated_purpose: Community forum on South L.A. priorities
observable_function: Separate on-stage conversations with each candidate, moderated by CALO News
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: the runoff's only documented South L.A. forum, conducted as sequential interviews rather than a debate.
target_audience: Black and Latino South L.A. residents
main_messages: "Black and brown poor folks the most have been central in my administration"; representation is about collaboration, not faces in a room
policy_issues: Homelessness; housing density; policing; immigration enforcement
speech_summary: Bass defended LAPD conduct during ICE operations, called the current homelessness approach "completely disfunctional", and opposed density in some neighborhoods.
opponent_reference: Contrasted with Raman on density and LAPD
analyst_notes: LAist body text says "Saturday"; the same page's photo caption says Sept. 29 (a Tuesday). 2026-09-26 is the Saturday consistent with publication on Oct. 3, so that date is recorded and the conflict flagged.

event_title: Jewish Federation of Los Angeles mayoral forum
stated_purpose: Forum hosted by a coalition of Jewish organizations
observable_function: Back-to-back on-stage interviews with Spectrum News One host Alex Cohen; broadcast on LAist 89.3
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: the race's international-politics moment, with Gaza framing separating the candidates.
main_messages: Differing language on Gaza; municipal competence
speech_summary: Bass and Raman gave different descriptions of the Gaza war in separate interviews.
media_coverage: LAist (report plus 1:39:47 audio); Jewish Federation video
analyst_notes: Forum audio hosted on the LAist article; the JFEDLA YouTube upload is dated 2026-09-30.

event_title: NBC4 / Telemundo 52 runoff debate
observable_function: Televised debate with a three-journalist panel
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: the sharpest personal exchange of the race; Bass attacked Raman's fitness rather than defending her own record.
target_audience: Citywide television audience, English and Spanish
main_messages: "Now is not the time to turn the city over to Nithya Raman"; Raman would put LAPD in "disarray" before the Olympics
speech_summary: Bass repeatedly accused Raman of lying about her record, said the mayor's office had to absorb constituent service in Raman's district, and closed with the "not the time" line.
analyst_notes: Venue from the Wikipedia debate list; the NBCLA upload confirms date and format. CalMatters names the panel: Conan Nolan, Colleen Williams, Alejandra Ortiz.

event_title: Rick Caruso says he will vote for Bass
stated_purpose: Televised interview statement by the 2022 runner-up
observable_function: ABC7 exclusive interview
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: a personal vote commitment, not a formal endorsement — Caruso declined to endorse.
main_messages: "Extreme concern" about Raman
analyst_notes: Recorded as an endorsement-adjacent event because the L.A. Times reported Caruso "declines to endorse" the same day.

event_title: First reported challenge to Bass from the left
stated_purpose: Publicly float a progressive challenge to the incumbent
observable_function: L.A. Times newsletter item
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: an early trial balloon, three months before the filing deadline.
main_messages: A left challenge is possible
analyst_notes: Metered article; the newsletter headline is the only retrievable text and it does not name Raman in the headline itself.

event_title: Enters the mayor's race at the filing deadline
stated_purpose: Launch a mayoral campaign against the incumbent she had endorsed
observable_function: Filing and public announcement hours before the deadline
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: a late entry that converted an ally into the challenger and reshaped the field.
target_audience: Citywide progressive, renter and YIMBY voters
main_messages: City Hall is not delivering; housing and homelessness need a different approach
media_coverage: Los Angeles Times; LAist; New York Times (not retrievable)
analyst_notes: The NYT report cited by Wikipedia ("only hours before the filing deadline") returned a URLError and could not be read; exact filing time unknown.

main_messages: Change versus the incumbent record
media_coverage: Los Angeles Times; Sherman Oaks HOA video

event_title: Tenant-protections event with renters
observable_function: Meeting with renters during the final week of the primary

main_messages: Rent stabilization; eviction protection
visual_notes: Photo caption only: Raman "speaks during a campaign event about tenant protections with renters in Los Angeles".
analyst_notes: Known only from a CalMatters photo caption; no venue, crowd or speech text reported.

event_title: City Controller Kenneth Mejia endorsement
stated_purpose: Joint campaign announcement with the city controller
observable_function: Joint announcement criticising City Hall spending
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: pairs the challenger with the city's fiscal watchdog, turning the budget into a corruption-adjacent argument.
main_messages: A $1 billion LAPD contract triggered a fiscal crisis; restore the controller's oversight authority
opponent_reference: Criticism of City Hall spending under Bass
analyst_notes: The "$1 billion LAPD contract" is the campaign's and controller's characterisation, reported as a claim.

event_title: Carpenters training-facility tour and Western States Carpenters endorsement
observable_function: Tour of a training facility, speech to apprentices, bilingual remarks
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: a democratic socialist making a deregulation-and-build argument to building-trades workers — the race's most counter-intuitive coalition moment.
main_messages: "You are the people who build Los Angeles ... together, we are going to build its future"; mayors do not build housing
speech_summary: Raman pledged a construction wave, said "Mayors don't build housing", and moved between English and Spanish.
opponent_reference: Noted the carpenters backed Bass in 2022
visual_notes: Column describes "a cheering crowd of workers" chanting her name; no image published in the retrieved text.
analyst_notes: Crowd size unknown; the column says "dozens of working men and women".
